title: Create an Extension Pack
summary: Create an extension pack in greentic-pack using the current pack doctor, control hook, and package validation flow.

modules.title: Create the Pack Shape
modules.objective: Start with the extension-pack manifest and keep shared contracts imported from greentic-types.

steps.instruction: Create or update the pack manifest with extension-pack metadata and owner repo details.
steps.expected_output: The extension pack manifest and source layout are generated.

steps.instruction: Import provider, hook, observer, or static-route contracts from greentic-types rather than copying local DTOs.
steps.expected_output: The pack compiles against shared contract crates.

modules.title: Add Control Hooks
modules.objective: Use current control hook extension points for runtime behavior instead of legacy lifecycle scripts.

steps.instruction: Register control hooks in the pack manifest and point them at typed component exports.
steps.expected_output: The manifest includes typed control hook entries.

steps.instruction: Run pack doctor before publishing or wiring the pack into a bundle.
steps.expected_output: Doctor reports no manifest, hook, or component binding failures.

deprecated_commands.reason: Provider, hook, observer, and static-route contracts are owned by greentic-types.
Extension packs should declare typed control hooks in the manifest.
